Hi there! I need some help with a few exchanges and a cancellation from my recent orders. I’d like to exchange a bicycle for a larger frame size for my kid, and also swap out a jigsaw puzzle from the same order for one with about 1000 more pieces—preferably with an art theme instead of animals, if that’s possible. 

Additionally, I want to exchange a camera I ordered for one with a slightly lower resolution, but I’d like to keep all the other features the same. For both exchanges, I’d prefer to use my Visa card for any payments or refunds.

Lastly, I need to cancel just the skateboard from one of my orders. Can you help me with all of this?
I actually don’t remember which email I used for the order, but my name is Sofia Li and my zip code is 78260. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my account!
That sounds good to me—please go ahead and review the orders. Let me know if you need any more details from my side to make sure everything matches up correctly.

Thanks for pulling up all the details! Here are my preferences:

- For the bicycle, yes, please exchange it for a large frame size of the same model.
- For the jigsaw puzzle, if there’s a 1500-piece art-themed puzzle, that would be perfect. If not, 2000 pieces is fine too, as long as it’s still art-themed.
- For the camera, I’d like to exchange it for a similar model with a slightly lower resolution—maybe around 20MP if that’s available—but I want to keep the 3x zoom and SD card storage.
- And yes, please use my Visa card ending in 6791 for any payments or refunds.
- Lastly, please go ahead and cancel just the skateboard from order #W8855135.

Let me know if you need anything else from me!

Thanks for checking! I’d really prefer to keep the same type and color for the bicycle, so if a large green road bike isn’t available, I’d rather wait or skip the exchange for now. Please let me know if you can get that specific model in a large size.

For the jigsaw puzzle, the 1500-piece art-themed option sounds perfect—please go ahead with that exchange.

The 20MP camera with the same features is exactly what I wanted, so I’m good with that exchange too.

And yes, please cancel just the skateboard from order #W8855135.

Everything else looks good, and you can use my Visa card ending in 6791 for any payments or refunds. Let me know if you need anything else from me!
Yes, that’s correct—I’ve listed everything I want to exchange and I only want to cancel the skateboard from my pending order. Please go ahead and process these changes. Thank you!

Great, thanks for confirming everything and for your help! I’ll keep an eye out for the return instructions and the refunds. If the large green road bike becomes available later, I’ll reach out again. Have a good day! 

###STOP###
